problems.explain: Break each into components: 18 at 270° is ⟨18 cos 270°, 18 sin 270°⟩ ≈ ⟨0, −18⟩; 7 at 180° is ⟨7 cos 180°, 7 sin 180°⟩ ≈ ⟨−7, 0⟩. Adding, the resultant is about ⟨−7, −18⟩. Its length is √((−7)² + (−18)²) ≈ 19.3132. So it is 19.3 mph.
